THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT("Agreement") dated as of July 18. 2005 between 259 4TH AVENUE LLC, having an address at 66 West Broadway, New York. NY 10007 ("Transferor") and ESSEX FOURTH AVENUE LLC, a New York limited liability company. having an address at c/o Essex Capital Partners Limited, 635 Madison Avenue. New York. NY10022 ("Transferee"; Transferor and Transferee are sometimes hereinafter each referred to singly as a "party" and collectively as the "parties.") WITNESSETH THAT: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of certain land ("Transferor's Land") in the City of New York. and the building and improvements thereon ("Transferor's Building"), located at 259 4lh Avenue. Brooklyn. New York and known as Block 961, Lot 2 on the Tax Map (the "Tax Map") of the City of New York (the "City"), Kings County and more particularly described in Building being herein called "Transferor's Premises"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain land ("Transferee's Land") in the City of New York, and the building and improvements thereon ("Transferee's Building"). located at 255 4ih Avenue, Brooklyn, New York and known as Block 961. Lot 3 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, together with Transferee's Building being herein called "Transferee'sPremises");and WHEREAS, Transferee proposes to construct a new building on Transferee's Land, (said new building and improvements and any related improvements, additions, renovations. expansions, alterations. restorations, repairs, replacements and reconstructions thereto and thereof being collectively called"Transferee's NewBuilding"); and WHEREAS, it is anticipated that Transferee's New Building will contain more floor area and bulk. as the terms Floor Area and bulk are defined in the Zoning Resolution (the "Zoning Resolution") of the City of New York, effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time, than is now available for use in respect of Transferee's Premises under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution, with the result that Transferee desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Transferee's Premises and

Transferor's Premises into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of making available to Transferor additional Floor Area for inclusion in Transferee's New Building. WHEREAS. such procedure will make available to Transferee a portion of the currently unused Floor Area attributable to Transferor's Premises as of the date hereof, being all of the Floor Area currently available to Transferor's Premises under the current Zoning Resolution in excess of the Floor Area utilized by Transferor's Premises and the development rights associated with such unused Floor Area less 951 square feet of Floor Area which shall be retained by Transferor, (hereinafter such unused Floor Area and associated development rights less 951 square feet of Floor Area collectively referred to as the "Excess Development Rights"); and WHEREAS, the parties represent that the Excess Development Rights is estimated to total approximately 9.831 square feet; and WHEREAS, Transferor is willing to make the Excess Development Rights available to between Transferor and Transferee; and WHEREAS. Transferor and Transferee are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions as referred to in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (definition ot "zoning lot", paragraph (d) ("Declaration", attached hereto as Schedule D), which ("Combined Zoning Lot") out of Transferee's Premises and Transferor's Premises; and NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, Transferor and Transferee hereby agree as follows: (1) Certain Definitions.As used herein: (a) "Floor Area", "floor area ratio", "zoning lot", "part(ies) in interest", "lot area", "use". "bulk" and "non-complying" shall have the meanings set forth in §12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. (2) Transfer of Excess Zoning Rights: Easement of Light and Air. (i) Transferor hereby sells, conveys, assigns and transfers to Transferee all right, title and interest of Transferor in and to the Excess Development Rights and agrees that Transferee may utilize the Excess Development Rights in the construction of Transferee's New Building.
